Subject: Routing policy pre-read + requested artifacts

Rajesh / team,

Attaching a short pre-read that outlines the routing patterns we typically recommend for this use case. Highlights:
- Model selection: prefer a small set of validated models (high-quality primary, cost-balanced secondary)
- Fallback rules: time-based and error-threshold fallbacks; automatic switch to cached responses for known prefixes
- Region tiering: prefer single-region primary with cross-region fallback only for session continuity-sensitive endpoints
- Canary and A/B: recommend canary rollout with 5% traffic for any new routing rule

Please share your sample traffic CSV and any SLO targets (95th/99th latency, token-cost ceilings). For the prompt review, the sample_prompt_set.json you received has typical edge-cases; flag anything you want us to prioritize.

Vivek: Ill coordinate the load-test plan with you; I added a baseline spreadsheet.

-Neha
